messages:
incidentbot: ALERT INC-2026: inference-router error rate spike -> paging attempted but outbound paging returned errors; automatic suppression detected. Manual triage needed.

pagerbot: saw multiple 403s from paging gateway: 'suppressed_by_policy'. Paging retries queued but not delivered.

erica: oncall here — are users impacted or is this internal metrics spike?
mike: customer reports of timeouts from some EU region, correlating with a surge in 500s from inference-router. Could be real user impact.
maria: posting recent log from paging gateway and suppressor:

```
[2026-03-10T11:02:03Z] paging.outbound id=pg-9a2 status=403 reason="suppressed_by_policy" rule=tag-match-v2 header.X-CDN-Tag="edge-rollout-7"
[2026-03-10T11:02:04Z] paging.outbound id=pg-9a3 status=403 reason="suppressed_by_policy" rule=tag-match-v2 header.X-CDN-Tag="edge-rollout-7"
[2026-03-10T11:02:05Z] incidentbot: escalate_attempts=4 last_error=suppressed_by_policy
```

erica: that rule name 'tag-match-v2' looks new — any recent deploy that touched the notifier/proxy?
mike: infra rolled a CDN header normalization change in last deploy (rev: cdn-normalize-2026-03-10). It prepends X-CDN-Tag which our suppressor interprets as a reliability tag and matches the rule.
oncall-josh: I tried to call the oncall phone but pages didn't go through. I just hit the mobile oncall list directly. I'm on the bridge.
maria: mitigation: recommend disabling the suppressor rule temporarily and re-routing pages to fallback pager (pager-fallback-1).

```
# disable suppressor and force fallback
/infra toggle-pager-suppressor --id tag-match-v2 --disable --reason "emergency: misfire due to CDN header"
/infra route-pager --to pager-fallback-1 --incident INC-2026
```

erica: doing the disable now.

pagerbot: confirm: suppressor tag-match-v2 disabled by erica at 11:03:12Z.
oncall-josh: manual pages now arrived; teams are joining bridge. Customer impact: ~120 requests failed over 3m from EU cluster, some timeouts surfaced to customers.
mike: spinning up extra inference-router pods in EU and scaling quota, watching error rate.
maria: root cause hypothesis: suppressor rule used a naive substring match against X-CDN-Tag; header value from CDN changed and false-positive matched. Need to tighten rule to only match header=cdn_block:true or similar.
erica: filing follow-up action items: 1) revert naive tag-match rule and replace with explicit blocklist, 2) add unit tests for suppressor rules, 3) add end-to-end paging test on deploy. I'll open PR and run postmortem.
mike: PR opened: github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/1234 — includes test harness and a rollback for cdn-normalize if needed.
oncall-josh: incident status: mitigated (paging restored, traffic stabilized). Assigning postmortem to erica/maria. Creating retro ticket and notifying customers impacted.
maria: note for postmortem: consider pagers' visibility during partial failures — add alert that flags "paging suppression active" to SRE channel.
erica: thanks all. Closing live thread, will post formal incident summary in ~30m. :white_check_mark:
